gaps.explanation: Re-read pp1-14. Nothing printed is missing and nothing is counted twice. Exhibit E (p4) Total Revenues 12,281,140 = General 7,186,041 + Street 2,033,653 + Capital Projects 16,266 + Debt Service 2,159,971 + Other Governmental 885,209. Detail per fund: General Fund Exhibit P (p10) 7,186,041 (= p4); nonmajor Exhibit O (p9) 885,209 (= p4); Capital Projects p4 column 616 + 12,400 + 3,250 = 16,266 (= p4); Street and Debt Service only from Exhibit L (p8, budgetary basis; the General Fund columns of Exhibit L are not in detail). Street: Exhibit L 917,745 + 67,681 + 137,927 + 245,500 + 641,690 = 2,010,543 vs Exhibit E 2,033,653 (schedule 23,110 short). Debt Service: Exhibit L 1,138,243 + 15,481 + 396,373 + 44,607 = 1,594,704 vs Exhibit E 2,159,971 (schedule 565,267 short; Exhibit E Debt Service prints Special Assessments 530,401, Intergovernmental 100,705, Grants 16,522, Misc 65,604, Interest 1,249 that the budgetary schedule groups differently, and Exhibit L prints a further 'Other Financing Sources' 658,583, in detail as other financing). 23,110 + 565,267 = 588,377 = the gap. Adding the Exhibit E Street/Debt Service column rows would count those funds twice (budgetary + GAAP). Statement lines in the JSON equal p4.

Exhibit E (p4) Total Expenditures 13,510,854 = General 5,805,276 + Street 1,071,033 + Capital Projects 3,686,755 + Debt Service 2,252,861 + Other Governmental 694,929. Detail: General Fund pp11-14 5,805,277 (Park Capital Outlay 22,925 on p14 vs 22,924 on p4), nonmajor 694,929, Capital Projects 4,850 + 3,681,905 (p4 column) tie. Street: Exhibit L (p8) Streets 842,981 + Capital Outlay 226,185 = 1,069,166 vs p4 1,071,033 (1,867 short). Debt Service: Exhibit L prints no expenditure row for the fund; all its outflows are the single row 'Other Financing Uses' 2,122,285 (in detail, section other financing, label as printed), while p4 prints Capital Outlay 108,283 + Lease Payments 10,937 + Bond Payments 2,133,641 = 2,252,861. 1,867 + 2,252,861 - 1 (rounding) = 2,254,727 = the gap. The Debt Service spending is inside the 2,122,285 detail line, which cannot be split into the p4 rows; adding the p4 rows would count it twice.

p4 Transfers In 1,287,612 = Capital Projects 1,132,921 (in detail) + Debt Service 154,691. The Debt Service Fund's schedule (Exhibit L p8) prints no transfer row; its financing inflows are the one line 'Other Financing Sources' 658,583 (in detail) vs p4 Debt Service Total Other Financing Sources 270,225 (Transfers In 154,691 + Bond 18,651 + Loan 56,350 + Lease 40,533). The 154,691 is inside that budgetary line, which cannot be split. Gap 154,691.

p4 Transfers Out (1,287,612) = General (296,697) + Street (990,915). General Fund transfers out in detail (pp11-14) total 296,697. The Street Fund's 990,915 is in detail as Exhibit L (p8) 'Other Financing Uses' -990,915 (same amount, printed label kept), so the transfers check does not count it. Nothing missing.

p4 Debt Service column prints Bond Proceeds 18,651 + Loan Proceeds 56,350 + Capitalized Lease Proceeds 40,533 = 115,534 (= JSON debt_proceeds). Those are inside the Debt Service Fund's Exhibit L (p8) 'Other Financing Sources' 658,583 detail line, which cannot be split; adding them would count them twice. The schedule figure 51,228 is the General Fund Insurance Proceeds (p10 = p4), JSON other_financing. Gap 64,306 = 115,534 - 51,228.
